title: Concept: Knowledge-based questions returned with answers
description: A security question list that carries the stored answers in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The answers are a second factor based on facts an attacker can often find, and returning them removes even that weak protection.
applicability: Deployments that render a security question list that carries the stored answers into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The answers are a second factor based on facts an attacker can often find, and returning them removes even that weak protection.
